title: 动词形式的结构限制
goal: 判断动词的句法功能并选择符合结构的已有形式。

points.label: 判断空位是否需要谓语动词
选择符合结构的既有动词形式

sources.title: 全国大学英语四、六级考试大纲（2016年修订版）

body.p: 谓语说明主语的动作或状态。动名词、不定式和分词不作谓语，在句中作主语、宾语、定语、状语等。
先看空位前面是主语、助动词还是介词，再从词库中选词形。词库中的词按原样代入，不改词形。

cards.title: 谓语与助动词
rows: The teams have finished the tests.
The guide has explained the route.
The rain had stopped before noon.

cards.title: 非谓语与被动
rows: They discussed the plan before leaving.
She improved the design by testing it.
The team focused on measuring heat.
to 后接原形，表示目的
They paused to compare the readings.
The pipe carrying water is underground.
cards.note: 动名词和现在分词都以 -ing 结尾，要看它在句中的功能来区分。

items.stem: In 'The visitors observed the birds', what is the finite verb?
items.why: observed 是主语 visitors 的限定动词，即第二项。第四项还带上了宾语 the birds。

items.stem: In 'The machine stopped after producing ten parts', what is the function of 'producing'?
options: Finite verb of the main clause
Part of the object of after
items.why: producing 引出动名词短语，作介词 after 的宾语，即第四项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The cover can ___ the document'?
items.why: can 后接动词原形 protect，即第三项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The researchers have ___ the data'?
items.why: have 后接过去分词 analyzed，即第一项。

items.stem: In 'The box containing the tools was heavy', which word is the main-clause finite verb?
items.why: 主句谓语是 was；containing 引出修饰 box 的分词短语。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The files were ___ before delivery'?
items.why: were 与过去分词 checked 构成被动结构，即第二项。

items.stem: In 'The label identifies the source of the sample', what is the finite verb?
items.why: identifies 是主语 label 的谓语，即第一项。

items.stem: In 'The students paused to review their notes', what is the function of 'to review'?
options: The finite verb of the sentence
The object of the preposition to
items.why: to review 表示停下来的目的，主句谓语是 paused。

items.stem: In 'The path leading to the lake is narrow', which word is the main-clause finite verb?
items.why: is 是主句谓语；leading 引出修饰 path 的分词短语。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The team may ___ another method'?
items.why: may 后接动词原形 try，即第二项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'She recorded the result after ___ the sample'?
items.why: 介词 after 后用动名词 weighing，即第三项。

items.stem: Which word completes 'The reports have been ___ by the editor'?
items.why: have been 后用过去分词 reviewed 构成完成时的被动结构。
